WITH matched_scans AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, si.riskeval, sc.pressratio
  FROM scans AS sc
  INNER JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
), grouped AS (
  SELECT zoneref, riskeval, AVG(pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM matched_scans
  GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval
), shares AS (
  SELECT zoneregistry, COUNT(*) AS matched_scan_count
  FROM matched_scans
  GROUP BY zoneregistry
), ranked AS (
  SELECT g.zoneref AS site_code,
         g.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status,
         g.avg_pressratio,
         g.scan_count,
         g.scan_count::numeric / SUM(g.scan_count) OVER () AS scan_share,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY g.scan_count::numeric / SUM(g.scan_count) OVER () DESC) AS share_rank
  FROM grouped AS g
)
SELECT site_code, risk_evaluation_status, avg_pressratio, scan_count, scan_share
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY scan_share DESC;

assumptions.assumption: The scan share is each site's risk-status group's scan count divided by the total number of scans that match a site; NULL risk statuses form their own group.
